top_findings.title: standings splits Athletico Paranaense into two rows (name variant not reconciled)
top_findings.evidence: SoccerData.m:79-81 groups the table by the raw home/away string; Fold() (SoccerData.m:13-26) folds diacritics but does NOT reconcile 'Athletico' vs 'Atletico'. _factual.json: 2019 Serie A returns 'Athletico Paranaense' (27 matches, 48 pts) and 'Atletico Paranaense' (11 matches, 16 pts) as two clubs. Data-quality/factual defect (factual_accuracy=0.5); R9's criterion 'computed from matches, not hardcoded' IS met (SoccerData.m:76-88), so requirement_coverage is not reduced.
top_findings.suggestion: Group standings by a canonical team key (map 'athletico'->'atletico') so the same club's matches merge; reuse the same canonicalization at load time.
